value.rationale: The Petersen line graph is a canonical small four-regular network derived from a non-three-edge-colourable cubic graph. The precise one-contact to two-contact transition abolishes all 220,960 oscillatory attractors and gives a sharp six-update universal extinction at the critical equality rho(G)=theta=2 where the known generic density criterion is silent. The natural full-period, basin and hitting-time census is a reusable exact finite dynamical benchmark rather than a contrived partial computation.
